thread.title: Boeing's stock surges, adding over 70 points to the Dow's price - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Boeing's stock surges, adding over 70 points to the Dow's price - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Boeing Co. BA, +2.91% shot up 3.1% in afternoon trade, to provide the biggest boost to the Dow Jones industrial Average's DJIA, +0.81% price, after European rival Airbus SE AIR, +10.28% EADSY, +10.48% reported upbeat results . The aerospace giant's price gain of $10.56 was adding about 73 points to the Dow, which was up 211 points. The Dow's biggest percentage gainer was Cisco Systems Inc.'s shares CSCO, +4.47% which rallied 4.4% after better-than-expected quarterly results , but the price gain of $1870 only added 13 points to the Dow. Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, +3.04% was up 3.2% to be the second-biggest percentage gainer , with its $5.28 price gain adding 36 points to the Dow. Earlier Wednesday, Airbus's France-listed shares shot up 10.3% Thursday, after the company said it "overachieved on its 2017 guidance for all key performance indicators" amid record deliveries. Boeing's stock had soared 35.2% over the past three months, while Airbus shares have climbed 8.6% and the Dow has rallied 7.9%.
